about: Taste never blocks forever (Tim, 2026-10-25): if no taste call arrives after X hours the default ships. Low-risk things wait fast, high-risk things wait slow, and confidence in the proposed default shifts the wait. wait = baseHours[risk] x confidenceFactor[confidence], never below minHours. Starting values; tune here, not in code. Tim answering early always wins (a founder-taste receipt ends the wait).
